register.labelZh: SERVE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: serve as 和 serve for 可以表示某物有另一種角色或用途,例如把箱子用作桌子。；serve a notice on somebody 和 serve somebody with a notice 常用來表示正式送交法律文件。；serve something out 可以清楚表示某人服完整段刑期或餘下刑期。；serve something up 可以自然地表示準備食物,並把食物端給別人享用。
register.summaryEn: Serve as and serve for help you explain that something has a different role or purpose, such as a box being used as a table. Serve a notice on somebody and serve somebody with a notice commonly describe the official delivery of legal documents. Serve something out makes it clear that a person completes the whole sentence or its remaining part. Serve something up is a natural way to talk about preparing food and placing it before people to eat.
